drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s minimum is confidential and should not be disclosed. To move negotiations forward, propose a figure above that minimum with clear payment mechanics, while making the release and confidentiality terms workable.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is a revised draft with a proposed settlement amount and streamlined payment and release language. We have also clarified standard permitted disclosures and the timing and scope of the releases. Please let us know your client’s response so we can work toward prompt resolution.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. In full settlement of the claims released under this Agreement, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 14,500,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff’s counsel, within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall provide wire instructions reasonably in advance of the payment deadline.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and representatives, releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and their respective officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives from all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the claims asserted or that could have been asserted in the action through the Effective Date. Nothing in this Agreement releases obligations created by this Agreement.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep confidential the amount and terms of this settlement, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, auditors, insurers, tax advisors, and other professional advisors who are informed of the confidential nature of the information; as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental authority; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a legally required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
edits.name: Confidentiality
